Leah Turner: Quick thread to capture the all-hands Q&A on GTM/partners. I have three asks so teams can act: renewals triage, co-sell crediting, and partner portal ETA.
Tomás Valencia: Nice. Short answers up-front: renewals = next 90 days with ARR > $20k or any 'exec_alert' flag; co-sell = report influenced pipeline + mark attributed on close; portal = beta late-Oct (SSO dependency).
Priyanka S.: Adding operational notes: ops should publish a minimal CSV template (account, ARR, renewal_date, partner_referral, product_health) and a one-pager on what counts as an 'influenced' motion. I'll put drafts in #partners.
Leah Turner: For routing: if a partner-originated opp scales past $120k and partner remains engaged, keep partner as primary during Q3 pilot; do a joint-owner flag in CRM when field AE needs to step in.
Tomás Valencia: Metrics: marketing wants a weekly influenced number; revenue ops needs attributed closed-won for comp. Target: +20% influenced pipeline and 4 attributed partner-sourced closes this quarter.
Maya L.: Ops question: which saved view should Sales use for the renewal deck?
ops-bot: Use saved view "renewals_q4_triage". Nightly export scheduled to /ops/exports/renewals.csv. Reminder: upload template by Mon 09:00 PT.
Priyanka S.: PoC support: PS will prioritize partner-led PoCs for strategic partners with signed LOI; SLA details in the runbook I'll post Fri.
Leah Turner: Action items (short): 1) Ops -> publish CSV template + nightly export link (due Mon 09:00 PT). 2) Partnerships -> post 'influenced vs attributed' one-pager + playbook draft (due Wed). 3) PS -> PoC SLA runbook (due Fri). 4) Sales -> tag #partners early and set CRM flag `joint_gtm` if AE joins.
Tomás Valencia: I'll echo and fold into the leadership digest.
Priyanka S.: Posting draft in #partners now. Ping me if you want to be a pilot AE.
Leah Turner: Thanks all 44d will compile and send to execs. If anyone wants to add a follow-up, reply here.
